scripts.preview: node -e "import('node:http').then(({createServer}) => import('node:fs').then(({createReadStream}) => createServer((req, res) => { const path = req.url === '/' ? 'preview/preview.html' : req.url.slice(1); createReadStream(path).on('error', () => { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); }).on('open', () => res.writeHead(200)).pipe(res); }).listen(4173, () => console.log('Preview running at http://localhost:4173'))) )"
scripts.package: test -f .env && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && test -n "$COUCH_SERVER_URL" && rm -rf .package-tmp dist && mkdir -p .package-tmp dist && cp -R chrome-extension .package-tmp/couch-chrome-extension && sed -i '' "s#http://localhost:3000#${COUCH_SERVER_URL}#g" .package-tmp/couch-chrome-extension/content.js && (cd .package-tmp && zip -r ../dist/couch-chrome-extension.zip couch-chrome-extension) && rm -rf .package-tmp
scripts.release: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path='chrome-extension/manifest.json'; const source=fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8'); const match=source.match(/(\"version\"\s*:\s*\"\d+)\.(\d+)(\")/); if (!match) throw new Error('Manifest version must use n.n format'); const nextVersion=Number(match[2]) + 1; const next=source.replace(match[0], match[1] + '.' + nextVersion + match[3]); fs.writeFileSync(path,next); console.log('Bumped manifest version to ' + match[1].match(/\d+$/)[0] + '.' + nextVersion);" && pnpm package
